about.hero-text-1: My fascination with technology began at the age of 13. I grew up immersed in books by the industry's greatest innovators. Among them, Steve Jobs' vision and story became my greatest inspiration, fundamentally shaping my way of thinking.
about.hero-text-2: That impact was so strong that it pushed me out of my comfort zone to study abroad for a year, far from home. That adventure turned into one of the best experiences of my life, forging the engineering and design mindset I bring to every project today.
